bayts.text: And take away Satan and the plots toward a direction other than mine, and spare all of me the plotter.
And make the rest of my life a clear garden until my entry into the Garden.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O You Who are named Praiseworthy (Al-Ḥamīd) and Glorious (Al-Majīd),
bless with a blessing possessed of eternal gladness, with a peace that guards for me my father
from the narrowness of the grave and its torment together, (and) my mother, O Subduer Who repressed for me,
upon the Messenger, Your servant, the bearer of glad tidings, chief of every angel and man.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make through him this ordered poem the best worship, leading good to me.
And accept it from me generously, by the standing of him who surpassed the creatures of God, Lord of time.
And efface through him what grieved me in what has passed of my life, making my going forward clear for me.
And make my tongue remembering like my heart, O Enricher by Your repelling and drawing.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O You Who are named Kind (Ar-Raʾūf) and Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm),
bless with a blessing whose benefit is not cut off, upon him through whom harm to me is cut off,
with a peace that makes my life grow for me with the best of good and the most exalted spoil,
upon the means of access, the intercessor, the ladder, the Arab, the Hāshimite, the banner.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And guard Your Book with my heart and my hand and with my tongue, abiding with what most benefits.
And protect my dwellings and my family, (I) reciting, and drive my adversaries toward a direction other than mine.
O Allah, O All-Merciful, O Most Merciful, O You Who have been named "Sovereign" (Al-Malīk) and "King" (Al-Malik),
Bless with a blessing that turns kings toward other than my harm; You have led dominion to me,
with a peace that turns all people toward what gladdens all of me, and gather (good things) for me,
upon him through whom You created all that You created, servant, Messenger, banner.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And bestow on Your servant and beloved, the intimate, the excellent that multiplies the little for him.
And grant him the happiness of the two Abodes, O You Who spared him disgrace like the two fires.
And grant him enabling grace in every refuge, and make his life for him the finest of favours.
And grant him the months and the days as gladness for him, and protect him from widowhood.
And turn the seasons and the years toward his gladness, and tame the disciplines for him.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O You Who are named Patient (Aṣ-Ṣabūr) and Forbearing (Al-Ḥalīm),
bless with Your blessing that does not cross the mind of any eloquent one who may write,
with a peace that the peace of creatures does not resemble, upon him who comprises the all-embracing words.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And enrich me, O my Benefactor, with gratitude, (freeing me) from patience, forbearance and all stratagem.
And make by Your mighty grace my intention, like word and deed, the guidance of all of me.
And free me from what necessitates patience and what necessitates forbearance, and reward my writing with thanks.
And make my writing like the pilgrimage, the fast and the prayer; save my family.
And put good pleasure in place of forbearance for me, and put benefit in place of injustice for me.
And make the sweetness of worship, in my worship, put endurance to shame.
And grant me aversion from sins, O You Who spared me the harm of every rebel.
O You Who protected me from Your misleading enemies: to You be my gratitude before the day of Tarwiya (8 Dhū l-Ḥijja)
and after it: so accept my gratitude from me, and raise it to the mighty Throne on my behalf.
Raise my gratitude from me to the Footstool, by the sanctity of the lofty, most holy Name.
